Exhibit A — The Story

A family. With subs.

In 2016, Sons of Pitches free agency handed gaffer Pat Harmon a roster of complete randos. A decade of organized winning later, the Goalfellas sit tied for 8th on the league's all-time championship list — across every division, age level, and competition — with an estimated 1000 wings eaten at Vickery's in post-match meet-ups along the way.

“We’re just a bunch of dudes who loved to play. The fact that we all became friends outside of Goalfellas shows the character of this club.”— Pat Harmon

The code is short:

  • Don’t be an asshole.
  • Show up ready and work hard for everyone around you.
  • Carry the groceries.
Item 01 — The Hot Saucehandle with gloves
Applied liberally. Regretted instantly.
Item 02 — The Wingschampionship protocol
The world’s hottest wing sauces, sampled only after winning the league.
Item 03 — The Rocktool of the trade
Recovered from the back of the net. Six times over.
